newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds close with few trades reported.
newsitem.headline: European feeds close with few trades reported.

text.p: European meals and feeds closed with few major trades reported on Thursday as the strong dollar combined with a fluctuating Chicago outlook to drive continental consumers underground.

"We've got a dollar well above 1.80 marks and there's just no confidence in this market," one trader said. "The currency makes it very difficult to do business." Trades were limited nearby positions in South American soymeal.
Elsewhere, the effects of swine fever were still being felt with demand for products such as tapioca at a very low ebb.
